hero.body: Every listing on Proland is reviewed by our team before going public. No ghost properties, no payment before you've seen the place.

home.featured_desc: Hand-picked listings from verified owners — each reviewed before going live.

step1.title: Find a Property
step1.desc: Browse our curated list of verified homes and plots across Tanzania. Every listing has been reviewed by our team before it goes live.

step2.title: Request a Visit
step2.desc: Schedule a site visit in one click and communicate directly with the verified owner via WhatsApp. No agents, no middlemen, no commission conversations.

step3.title: Secure Your Deal
step3.desc: Confirm payment only after you've inspected the property. You have 3 days to decline at no cost — Proland's site-visit policy, not a legal disclaimer.

trust.title: Why Proland
trust.verified_desc: Every property is admin-reviewed before going public.
trust.visit_desc: Book a site visit, inspect the property, then decide.
trust.contact_desc: WhatsApp the owner directly — no intermediary fees.

cta.owner_title: Have a Property to Sell or Rent?
cta.owner_desc: List for free. Once our team approves your listing, it's live to thousands of verified buyers.
